verdict.rationale: Ramp documents in-platform travel booking (ramp-docs-61, ramp-docs-4) with policy shown at booking time: "See policy status for every option… no wondering if trips will get rejected" (ramp-docs-18). Per diem adjusts automatically by location and duration (ramp-docs-19), and hotel rebooking is automatic (ramp-docs-20). Missing for 10: flights are never named explicitly, there are no details on whether out-of-policy options are blocked or routed for pre-approval, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
